WITH ['pulsar-broker-4.2.5.jar','pulsar-broker-common-4.2.5.jar','pulsar-client-original-4.2.5.jar','pulsar-client-api-4.2.5.jar','pulsar-common-4.2.5.jar','pulsar-metadata-4.2.5.jar','managed-ledger-4.2.5.jar'] AS jars
MATCH (a:Artifact:Jar)-[:CONTAINS]->(t:Type) WHERE a.fileName IN ['/'+jars[0],'/'+jars[1],'/'+jars[2],'/'+jars[3],'/'+jars[4],'/'+jars[5],'/'+jars[6]] AND t.fqn STARTS WITH 'org.apache.pulsar.' AND NOT t.fqn CONTAINS '$' AND NOT t.fqn ENDS WITH 'package-info' AND (t:Class OR t:Interface OR t:Enum OR t:Annotation OR t:Record)
WITH collect(DISTINCT t) AS targets
MATCH (a2:Artifact:Jar)-[:CONTAINS]->(s:Type) WHERE a2.fileName IN ['/pulsar-broker-4.2.5.jar','/pulsar-broker-common-4.2.5.jar','/pulsar-client-original-4.2.5.jar','/pulsar-client-api-4.2.5.jar','/pulsar-common-4.2.5.jar','/pulsar-metadata-4.2.5.jar','/managed-ledger-4.2.5.jar']
MATCH (s)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(t) WHERE t IN targets AND NOT split(s.fqn,'$')[0] = t.fqn
RETURN t.fqn, count(DISTINCT s) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 12
